slice: Versioned DWG BLOCK_RECORD XREF metadata submission and writer route
problem: The DWG writer's block-definition route accepted only name/base point/units, so BLOCK_RECORD XREF flags, legacy index, path and metadata were silently emitted as ordinary-block defaults. A follow-up source/spec audit also found that the first implementation incorrectly conflated the DWG loaded bit with DXF BLOCK group-70 bit 32 (resolved); these are separate states.

spec_evidence.dwg_source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.52, pp. 164-165 (local authoritative reference)
spec_evidence.dxf_source: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2021/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-66D32572-005A-4E23-8B8B-8726E8C14302.htm (group 70: bit 32 denotes a resolved external reference/dependent reference and is ignored on input)
spec_evidence.dxf_unload_source: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbBlockTableRecord::setIsUnloaded says the unloaded state is the first bit of DXF group 71 and is set when isUnloaded() is true: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2018/ENU/OARX-RefGuide/files/OREF-AcDbBlockTableRecord__setIsUnloaded_bool.html
spec_evidence.independent_reader_cross_check: ACadSharp keeps BlockTypeFlags (including DXF group-70 XRefResolved bit 32) separate from Block.IsUnloaded, reads the DWG raw bit into IsUnloaded, and writes unloaded state as DXF group 71: https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/blob/master/src/ACadSharp/IO/DWG/DwgStreamReaders/DwgObjectReader.cs and https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/blob/master/src/ACadSharp/IO/DXF/DxfStreamWriter/DxfBlocksSectionWriter.cs
spec_evidence.wire_contract: For R2000+, ODA says DWG loaded bit zero means loaded and one means unloaded. Map it to a separate BLOCK group-71 unload property, never to BLOCK group-70 bit 32 (resolved). The common XREF hard-pointer slot is specified as NULL.

owners: DWG BLOCK callback propagation to DRW_Block
changes: Add a non-pure, fail-closed metadata overload; preserve the existing name/base-point/units API and DRW_Interface vtable.
Encode legacy xrefindex+1, XREF/dependency/overlay flags and common path/description/preview fields, plus R2007+ units/explodability/scaling.
Map R2000+ raw loaded bit zero/one to a separate xrefUnloaded property and DXF BLOCK group 71; leave group-70 bit 32 as resolved status. Generated vectors exercise both independent values.
Emit the ODA-specified null common hard-pointer value; reject a non-null retained model value before output publication.
Refuse unsupported common fields, unrepresentable versions/values, and local entity/INSERT content inside XREF blocks.
implementation.publicApiChange: Additive dwgRW overload and non-pure internal writer method. Public DRW_Block and DRW_Block_Record gain a separate xrefUnloaded bool; DRW_Block_Record already gained a public xrefIndex field in the preceding parser slice, changing layout. Downstream binaries must be rebuilt. No DRW_Interface virtual changed.
implementation.adapterIdentityComposition: Not implemented; DXF BLOCK↔BLOCK_RECORD source-identity matching remains required before converter integration.
implementation.independentBitWalker: Implemented in the focused test: independently walks emitted BLOCK_RECORD body bits (type/common preamble, legacy index, resolved/dependent flags, overlay and separate unloaded state) before production parser read-back across all six supported writer versions. It does not independently decode full frame/container layout or modern string streams.

assertions: Legacy xrefindex+1 including a value above INT16_MAX.
XREF, overlay, dependent/resolved flags and loaded/unloaded state as independent properties with both raw loaded-bit polarities.
DXF BLOCK group 71 unloaded state survives generated ASCII and Binary parse/write; group-70 bit 32 is not used as its substitute.
A test-local bit cursor inspects the raw body emitted by the concrete version writer before invoking the production reader.
Empty and relative paths, description, preview, base point and R2007+ insertion metadata.
No local content or INSERTs are admitted into an XREF block; a following ordinary block remains intact.
Non-null hard-pointer model values and overlay-only (without XREF) flags are refused before publication and leave no output file.

fixture_policy: All input bitstreams and DWG outputs are generated locally for the focused tests and removed from a temporary directory. No downloaded/customer DWG/DXF fixture is added.
evidence_ceiling: Generated writer output is checked by a test-local bit walker for core numeric fields and then by the production decoder. Full object-frame/container and modern string-stream conformance, peer/native CAD acceptance, external-file resolution, XREF dependency graph/overlay composition, and DXF-origin BLOCK↔BLOCK_RECORD identity composition remain unqualified; this slice promotes no format-support claim.
next_unresolved: Establish source BLOCK/BLOCK_RECORD identity and unsupported-field preflight in the converter before routing imported XREF metadata through this API. Keep full frame/string-stream conformance and peer/native acceptance at their composed gates.
